name: SuiteCRM
description: Module Loader downloads from depot.sugarcrm.com with CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER=0, then include()s an unverified manifest.php — zero hash/signature. CDN/MITM = RCE. [Opus-verified: CONFIRMED-D]
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: The depot downloader disables TLS peer verification, and ModuleInstaller includes the downloaded manifest.php. This supports the admin depot channel; typical local-upload reachability is separate.
limitations: Source review is limited to the retained commit and does not establish released-artifact or current-upstream behavior.

'/manifest.php')` — no hash/signature check anywhere in the install path (only `md5_file` diffing of *local* files for conflict detection, `ModuleInstaller.php:2493`) |
